import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Radical
theorem p2_n001 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ≤ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ≤ p2v1)) (h2 : (p2v1 ≤ p2v0)) : (p2v0 ≤ p2v1) := by
  exact @LE.le.trans Nat _ p2v0 p2v2 p2v1 h0 h1

theorem p2_n002 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ≤ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ≤ p2v1)) (h2 : (p2v1 ≤ p2v0)) : (p2v0 = p2v1) := by
  exact @LE.le.antisymm Nat _ p2v0 p2v1 (p2_n001 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 h0 h1 h2) h2
